data.name: Moonfeather
data.detailed_description:
“Reaching this place with nothing but a mortal body… is truly impressive.
As an omniscient and omnipotent god, hehe… do you wish to know the truth?
If you want the answer, you must pay the price. Let me see if you truly possess the power to bear it.”

That day…

The tribe you lived in was consumed by a plague of black smoke.
Everyone within it died in this meaningless catastrophe.

For miles around, trees withered instantly, the land dried and cracked, and no living creature survived.

The tribe elder once said:

“This land is protected by Kai.
She will bless this earth and all of her people…”

But the nightmare that continued to linger in your dreams never disappeared.

To seek power.
To take revenge against the nightmare that haunted you.

You began searching for greater and stronger power.

Until the day you met her…

The power of Kai can burn away all impurities in this world.

Even… the moon in the sky.

But the proud flames of Kai will never allow a mortal to touch her fire.

Angry mortal…

If you wish to endure the power of the sun, then fight.

Use the blood of the apocalypse to temper your mortal body.
Use the blessings of the gods to make yourself stronger.

As for that shattered moon…

Beautiful, yet miserable.
A sight that brings sadness… even disgust.

But after all…

On the day you opened your eyes for the first time,
it was the only light that shone upon you.

Powers of the Valkyries

From the authorities of the gods who govern:

Protection, Sky, Rivers, Wealth, Speed, and War

The Valkyries transform their powers into weapons, which will randomly appear during your journey.

You can pick up and equip two weapons, combining their powers together.

Switch between them freely during battle, adapt to changing battlefield situations, and choose the weapon most suitable for different enemies.

By defeating enemies with the corresponding Valkyrie's weapon, you will earn their recognition and increase their favor toward you.

Divine Powers Beyond Weapons

Weapons are not the only gifts from the Valkyries.

After choosing a Valkyrie's authority weapon, you will gain her divine power.

These powers allow you to unleash the Valkyrie's exclusive abilities:

  • Small Skills

  • Big Skill

When you possess the authority of two Valkyries at the same time, their powers will expand and create additional Valkyrie synergy abilities—the hidden connection between their divine forces.

A total of six skills can be combined.

Through proper combinations, adaptation, and combat strategy, create your own powerful skill pool.

Perform incredible combat sequences, greatly increase Valkyrie favor, and unlock exclusive illustrations and special abilities.

Countless Blessings Guide Your Journey

Every Valkyrie has their own weapon blessings and universal blessings.

When holding a Valkyrie's weapon, you can receive blessings that enhance:

  • Weapon abilities

  • Skills

  • Exclusive mechanics

These blessings make your weapons easier to control and strengthen your divine powers.

Even without holding their weapons, you can still receive universal blessings from Valkyries and gain their enhancements.

Some blessings can directly modify the way divine powers are released, changing skill modules and making them better suited to your combat style.

Certain blessings can be obtained repeatedly, allowing you to create extreme builds and achieve overwhelming power.

Use every blessing wisely.

Create the perfect build.

Make every battle more satisfying and efficient.

A Unique Health System & Fluid Combat

Hide small amounts of instant damage and reward powerful burst combinations as well as high-speed continuous damage builds.

Experience the thrill of stacking massive damage to remove a huge portion of an enemy's health in a single strike.

Or unleash rapid attacks that continuously tear enemies apart.

With instant response and flexible movement systems, every action can be controlled and adjusted.

React to every enemy move.

Experience the satisfaction of defeating bosses and monsters with only a small amount of health remaining.

Everything Slows Down

When danger approaches, performing a perfectly timed dodge or releasing certain skills will slow down time itself.

Everything seems to stop.

In that brief moment, seize the opportunity and counterattack.

Feel the changing speed of time.

Move through the battlefield with precision.

Strike down every monster standing in your way.

Even in the most desperate moments…

Find your chance to fight back.

data.short_description: While searching for the truth behind the massacre of your home village, you unexpectedly encounter the fallen Moon Goddess; she chooses you and possesses your body, passing on her divine powers. Forced to accept her mission, you must battle your way through waves of monsters, fighting ever deeper.
data.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
